席墨还没查清楚事情的来龙去脉，之前爆料的工作室又开始爆料了。

这次爆的是夏萱在剧组耍大牌，欺负人的证据，有照片，也有视频。

在公众面前展现出来的夏萱，和那些照片视屏上的夏萱，恍如是两个人。有了前面的做铺垫，此时爆出来的这些东西，很快就被人接受了。

网上又掀起了一层层的风浪，将夏萱推到了风口浪尖。

之前那些被欺负的人碍于她影后的身份，只能忍着，这么好的机会，那些人怎么可能会在忍下去，纷纷雇水军，势必要把夏萱从神坛上拉下来。

“席总，那个工作室只有一个人，我们根本找不到他人。”席墨助理紧张的看着自家BOSS。

“查IP！”

“……也查不到。”助理双腿发软，说话都不利索了。

“查不到？”席墨的声音上扬了几分，“怎么会查不到？你们查不到，就找人查，这么简单的事，还需要我教你吗？”

助理手忙脚乱的退出去，联系人去查IP。

可惜那IP被时笙动过手脚，席墨的人怎么可能查得到。

相较于夏萱这边骂声不断，时笙新开播的电视剧却火了起来，时笙的人气也跟着上涨，而之前录的《极限世界》也开播，网上顿时热闹起来。

“小丸子一出场就是那么的逗，她考虑过摄影小哥的感受吗？求摄影小哥的心里阴影面积。”

“秋女神和小丸子站一起好般配，只有我一个人这么觉得吗？”

“摄影小哥幸苦了，跟了我们小丸子这么一个不靠谱的艺人，我代表小丸子后援会给摄影小哥敬礼。”

“楼上的楼上+1”

“小丸子的新剧萌得我一脸血，嗷嗷嗷，我要去继续添屏。”

“什么萌，明明是霸气好不好，我也要去添屏了！”

“嗷嗷嗷，那个精灵好美美美美！！”

“我也看到了，美出了新境界，简直就像是天使，我要换老公了！”

韩灵四人一出场，就用脸圈了不少粉，纷纷跑到极限世界官博下问这四只是哪个公司的，会不会出道之类的问题。

极限世界的官博很给面子，发了几张四人拍摄精灵时的单人照，又用合照凑够九宫格，最后艾特漫天娱乐。

这意思在明显不过了，这是漫天娱乐的人。

漫天娱乐不就是他们小丸子的公司吗？嗷嗷嗷，小丸子和精灵们一个公司，好幸福有木有！

唐隐早就准备好了这个时候，公司立即开发布会，宣布King组合正式出道，随后推出四人的首支MV。

而他们也被粉丝们称为精灵，不但因为他们有精灵一般的容貌，更有精灵一般的歌声。

一首歌，让四人瞬间火了起来。

Before Xi Mo found out the ins and outs of the matter, the studio that broke the news before started breaking the news again.

What was exposed this time was the evidence that Xia Xuan acted like a big star on the set and bullied others. There were photos and videos.

The Xia Xuan shown in front of the public and the Xia Xuan on the photo screen seemed to be two different people.With the previous foreshadowing, these things that were revealed at this time were quickly accepted.

There was another wave of turmoil on the Internet, pushing Xia Xuan to the forefront.

Those who were bullied before had no choice but to endure it because of her status as a movie queen. With such a good opportunity, how could those people endure it and hire trolls one after another to pull Xia Xuan off the altar?

"Mr. Xi, there is only one person in that studio, and we can't find anyone else at all." Assistant Xi Mo looked at his boss nervously.

"Check IP!"

"...I can't find it either." The assistant's legs were weak and he couldn't speak clearly.

"Can't find it?" Xi Mo's voice rose a little, "How come you can't find it? If you can't find it, just ask someone to check it. Do you still need me to teach you about such a simple thing?"

The assistant hurriedly exited, and the contact person checked the IP.

It's a pity that the IP was tampered with by Shi Sheng. How could Xi Mo's people find out.

Compared to Xia Xuan's constant scolding, Shi Sheng's newly aired TV series has become popular, and Shi Sheng's popularity has also increased. The previously recorded "Extreme World" has also been aired, and the Internet has become lively.

"Maruko-chan was so funny when she first appeared. Has she considered the feelings of the photographer? Please give the photographer a shadow in his heart."

"Goddess Qiu and Maruko-chan look so perfect together, am I the only one who thinks so?"

"The photographer is lucky to have such an unreliable artist like our Xiaowanzi. On behalf of Xiaowanzi's supporters, I salute the photographer."

“Upstairs upstairs +1”

"The cuteness of Maruko-chan's new drama makes my face bleed. Ouch, I'm going to continue adding more screens."

"It's so cute, it's obviously domineering, okay? I'm going to add a screen too!"

"Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah, that elf is so beautiful!!"

"I've seen it too. She's beautiful to a new level. She's like an angel. I want to change my husband!"

As soon as the four Han Lings appeared on the stage, they attracted a lot of fans with their faces. They all went to the official blog of Extreme World to ask questions such as which company these four are from and whether they will make a debut.

The official blog of Extreme World was very considerate. They posted several individual photos of the four of them when they were shooting elves, and then used group photos to complete the nine-square grid. Finally, Art Mantian Entertainment.

This meaning couldn't be more obvious, this is a person from Mantian Entertainment.

Isn't Mantian Entertainment their Xiaowanzi's company?Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa; Maruko and the elves in the same company; what a blessing!))

Tang Yin had already prepared for this moment, and the company immediately held a press conference to announce the official debut of the King group, and then released the first MV of the four members.

And they are also called elves by fans, not only because they have elf-like looks, but also have elf-like singing voices.

一首歌，让四人瞬间火了起来。
